name: Great Lift
summary: At the Great Lift, travelers cross between the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles. Tauren platforms carry people and supplies between the rim and canyon floor, while quilboar threaten the southern road.

sections.title: A Gateway Carved from Wood and Rope
sections.body: At the rim between the southern Barrens and Thousand Needles, two wooden platforms hang over the canyon. Heavy timber, braided rope, and counterweighted pulleys carry caravans, couriers, and warriors across the sheer drop. Brave Moonhorn watches from the top platform, and Grish Longrunner keeps watch below. They guide travelers along the road and help cargo pass safely.

sections.title: Dangers at the Rim
sections.body: The road to the Great Lift crosses hostile ground in the southern Barrens. Quilboar tribes have pushed south and now threaten the route between Thousand Needles and the northern trails. Travelers making the long journey must fend off razorfen raiders before they reach the wooden platforms.

faq.answer: Tauren designed and built the Great Lift to bridge the sheer gap between the Barrens and Thousand Needles' canyon floor.

faq.q: Why is traveling to the lift dangerous?
faq.answer: Quilboar from the southern Barrens have pushed toward the rim. Their raiding parties harass or ambush caravans and couriers on the way to the lift.

faq.q: Who watches over the Great Lift?
faq.answer: Brave Moonhorn and Grish Longrunner watch over the Great Lift. They assist Horde travelers and keep watch over the routes and surrounding wilderness.

faq.q: Where does the Great Lift lead?
faq.answer: The platforms carry travelers down to Thousand Needles' canyon floor and up into the southern Barrens.

angles.text: For the Horde, the lift links central Kalimdor to Thousand Needles and Shimmering Flats. It opens a vital route to those isolated reaches.
As a tauren, your people built the lift from sturdy timber and counterweights. It carries travelers across rugged country without scarring the earth.
